weekend_summary: Lando Norris claimed pole in a rain-hit Sao Paulo qualifying session and won the wet-dry-wet Grand Prix from Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar. Verstappen recovered from grid P21 and Mercedes secured the 2026 constructors championship. Rafael Camara made his Haas race debut alongside Oliver Bearman, replacing Esteban Ocon.

Q.summary: Norris took pole in heavy rain; the final grid was reshaped by several power-unit penalties.
